Agreement Specifics

Essential Legal Clauses in an 11-Month Rent Agreement

  1. Monthly Rent & Maintenance: Due date (e.g., 5th of every month) and breakdown of society maintenance fees.
  2. Security Deposit Refund Clause: Refund timeline (usually within 7-15 days of vacant possession) after deduction for actual physical damages.
  3. Lock-in Period & Notice Period: Standard 1-month or 2-month written notice period required by either landlord or tenant.
  4. Utility Bills & Property Maintenance: Electricity, water, gas pipeline, and Wi-Fi payment responsibilities.
